Bright, even lighting illuminates rows of clothing on silver racks in the background. (2) A woman with red hair styled in long pigtail braids and a matching red cap enters the frame, smiling broadly. She wears a black strapless top over a white undershirt. (3) A third woman wearing a black face mask and glasses joins them, standing between the man and the red-braided woman. They all gesture towards the clothing racks. (4) The man reaches into a rack and pulls out a light blue button-down shirt with thin white stripes. He holds it up to inspect the collar. (5) The woman with braids holds a pair of dark denim wide-leg pants against her waist to show their fit and style. (6) Montage sequence: close-up on a red flower-shaped button on a shirt collar, followed by a close-up of a black leather belt with a metal flower detail, then a shot of black Mary Jane shoes and white socks. (7) A person wearing a black cap, the striped shirt, a white top, and the denim pants walks and poses in the store, showcasing the full ensemble.
